extraction.name: Introduction to the CoNLL-2003 Shared Task: Language-Independent Named Entity Recognition
extraction.description: We describe the CoNLL-2003 shared task: language-independent named entity recognition. We give background information on the data sets (English and German) and the evaluation method, present a general overview of the systems that have taken part in the task and discuss their performance.
extraction.creator: Erik F. Tjong Kim Sang and Fien De Meulder
extraction.publisher: CNTS - Language Technology Group, University of Antwerp
extraction.citeAs: Tjong Kim Sang, E. F., & De Meulder, F. (2003). Introduction to the CoNLL-2003 Shared Task: Language-Independent Named Entity Recognition. arXiv:cs/0306050.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The English data was taken from the Reuters Corpus, consisting of Reuters news stories between August 1996 and August 1997. The German data was taken from the ECI Multilingual Text Corpus, extracted from the German newspaper Frankfurter Rundshau.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Reuters news stories (English) and Frankfurter Rundshau newspaper articles (German).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: English: August 1996 to August 1997; German: August 1992 to December 1992.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For all data, a tokenizer, part-of-speech tagger, and a chunker were applied to the raw data. The English data was tagged and chunked by the memory-based MBT tagger. The German data was lemmatized, tagged and chunked by the decision tree tagger Treetagger.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Named entity tagging of English and German training, development, and test data was done by hand at the University of Antwerp. Mostly MUC conventions were followed. An extra named entity category called MISC was added.
